items.title: Summer Teens 2021
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
It’s summer! Time to hit the beach and eat ice cream all day! Enjoy your teen life to the fullest with these cool and fashionable skins!

- 12 Stylish summer skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Samurai Legends
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Become a master of the sword! Role-play as a cool warrior from ancient Japan and fight epic battles! Will you become a legendary hero and famed fighter?

- 12 Samurai skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Anime Ninjas II
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Anime Ninjas returns for round two! Show your friends your parkour skills or give them the fright of their lives with a sneak attack from the shadows! Grab your shuriken and become a fierce warrior of ancient Japan!

- 8 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Animal Suits
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Do you like cute animals and want to show your friends which you like the most? Then this might be the right skin pack for you! Adorable onesies are yours to wear! 

- 8 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Anime Dream Team
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Imagine... You are living in a world full of fun, cool events and cute pets! Is it a dream? It has to be! Make your dreams come true and explore the world with your anime dream team!

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Kpop Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Have you ever dreamed of being a popstar, looking great everytime and being adored by everyone? This is your chance to become a Kpop star to enjoy popularity on your server!

- 12 Skins
- By Geniely

items.title: Freefall Warrior
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Freefalling.... The only thing pulling you is the earth's gravity. Get out there, drop off and feel the freedom. 

- 10 skins
- By Geniely

items.title: Mob Astronauts
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
These mobs fly with rockets, land on the Moon, explore Mars and our Solar System! Embark on a cool and epic space adventure, with these awesome monster skins!

- 12 Mob skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Adventure Heroes
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The adventure heroes need a new squad member to join them on their countless missions to protect the world! 

- 8 amazing hero skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Modern Treehouse
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
You have always dreamed of owning your own tree house? Here we go! Play alone or grab your friends and start your survival adventure high up in your luxurious mansions.

- Gigantic tree
- Perfect location to defend against mobs
- Cool elevator system
- Vanilla village nearby
- By Team Ethyria

items.title: Millionaire's Coast Mansion
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Enjoy views of the ocean, a modern villa, a marina and yachts! Live a life of luxury at this mansion fit for a millionaire!

- Modern mansion survival spawn
- Includes several furnished yachts
- By RareLoot

items.title: Superheroes Secret Base
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
At first glance, you wouldn't believe that this unassuming base is home to the greatest superheroes of our time. Here they live undisturbed and enjoy their lives. So better not betray them, because they are always ready for a fight.

- Awesome superhero base with rocket launchpad 
- Many rooms furnished in detail
- Can you find all the hidden chests?
- By Team Ethyria

items.title: Biomes Skyblock
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Explore the variety of biomes that Minecraft has to offer in a spin on the all-time popular Skyblock survival game! Can you survive or will you fall from the sky? Try your best with this cool version of everyone’s favourite mini-game!

- Skyblock with seven unique islands
- Extra Nether island
- Extra End island
- By Geniely

items.title: Megalodon
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Life on the underwater station has drastically changed ever since the attack. Deep in the depths of the vast ocean lurks a sea monster so large that it can eat you up in one bite! Can you defend the station against further attacks from the Megalodon?

- 3 amazing skins
- Trading system
- Acquire the submarine and explore the map
- Research station
- By Team Ethyria

items.title: Blocking Dead
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
In a world taken down by zombies, a small community is trying to survive. Now, this community is attacked by zombies and you are the only one that can protect its citizens! Kill zombies, buy effects, upgrade weapons, set traps, all this is waiting for you in Blocking Dead!
Will you survive all the waves?

- Zombie waves
- Special zombies
- Interactive NPCs
- By Enigma

items.title: Cyber Outpost
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
You have been sent out to an unknown planet in the far reaches of the galaxy to live in and maintain a remote base-camp! Start your galactic survival adventure with this spawn!

- Survival spawn
- By Rareloot

items.title: Noob vs Pro vs Hacker
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Which house suits your lifestyle more? Are you a noob or a pro? Or maybe a hacker after all?

- 3 modern mansions
- By Rareloot

items.title: The Fort of Captain GB
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The Fort of Captain GB is a town created by the fearless green-beard Captain.
Suddenly all the citizens mysteriously disappeared, leaving behind clues that no one could decipher.
Explore the town and be the first person to discover all the hidden clues and decipher the mystery.

- Huge fort town to explore
- Perfect for RPG
- 8 custom pirate skins
- By Ignibyte

items.title: Skyblock One Block
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Skyblock is too easy for you? Then try your hand at the One Block Challenge! 
Whenever you mine the block you get a random item or block! Explore the different islands and structures, equip yourself and face the Ender Dragon!

- Have fun playing!
items.changelog:
- Reworked the entire world with new islands, structures and loot!
- Added an empty nether world with some custom islands
- Updated the One Block behavior with all new item and block drops up to version 26.10

items.title: OK Boomers
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
Kids these days just don’t get it! Sit back, relax, and play golf or watch TV with your boomer friends. Become a member of everyone’s favorite generation with this amazing skin pack!

+ Includes 6 boomin' skins!

items.title: Floral Fairies
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Are you ready for your next fairytale journey? Pick any of these cute HD fairy skins and embark on your next magical adventure. Venture into the fantasy lands as you leave the urban city to embrace your inner magical creature. These fairies come from flower fields and all have colorful outfits matching their home flower!

~High-resolution designs
~Vibrant flowery look

items.title: Mob Bots
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Do you love Minecraft mobs? Or would you rather be a robot? Well, now you don't have to choose! Introducing Mob Bots, enemies that have gone through special transformations to become epic cyborgs! Lead your team in style as you explore the lands with an enhanced look to already cool designs- sure to impress anyone who sees them!

~Robotic twist to fan favorites

items.title: Skyblock Islands
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Skyblock but you can craft islands! Play your favorite gamemode with a unique twist. Explore with your friends or craft skyblock orbs which you can throw to spawn islands! Conquer hardcore boss-fights and earn epic rewards!

+ Infinite skyblock system!
+ Conquer 7 boss-fights!
+ 100x custom islands!
+ Unique survival experience!

! Play in single player or multiplayer

items.title: TNT World
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
NEW and EXPLOSIVE 25 TNTs in ONE WORLD!

+ MINI, GIANT, MEGA, and GIGA TNT!
+ TIMER, SPLITTER, and QUADRAL!
+ LAVA, WATER, and ACID TNT!
+ LUCKY, MANSION, and TREE!
+ DIAMOND and EMERALD rain!
+ ULTIMATE MECH SUIT!

! Only works in the world provided
